title: The Hearthseat on the Keel
caption: The Court's city, built over the Hearth a hundred and fifty leagues south-east of Sill, drawn cool and clean as its own surveyors would file it: the Weighing Hall with the grating of cold iron over the never-out fire and the Hearth shown in cut beneath the floor; Slate Row with the College of Assessors and its second file; the Steward's room, the sealed files, the bank where measures are pressed into newborn vessels, the rooms of fewer than twenty Kept, the back rooms, the printed notice, the Hearth Road from Greybank and the way out to the Nine Wells. Surveyed and filed in Y.H. 812, the Thin Year.
